content:
noah: Quick note — ran into a parity quirk: our Retrofit suspend endpoints behave differently under timeouts vs the Call<> path; can cause a second attempt for non-idempotent POSTs in some Android conditions.

kara: can you paste minimal repro?

noah: repro is tiny. server delays body write so call times out. Kotlin suspend service:
```kotlin
interface Api {
  @POST("/widgets")
  suspend fun createWidget(@Body body: Widget): ApiResponse
}
```
Java path uses Call<ApiResponse>. Our SDK adapter for suspend was doing `service.createWidget()` but we also had a wrapper that on IOException did `call.clone().execute()` for Call paths. The problem: the suspend adapter enqueues async and cancellation wiring differs; if a timeout triggers then our generic retry helper ends up re-executing for the suspend path in edge timing.

amos: so same retry helper used across both paths? suspend adapter -> internal Call -> retry helper sees IOException and retries?

noah: Exactly. The helper used coroutine context + a blocking fallback. On some Android devices (older ART gc scheduling + network slowness) the continuation resumes and the wrapper calls clone() which doesn't inherit cancellation, so server gets two POSTs.

qa-ling: how often? any customer hit?

noah: low frequency in production but reproducible on emulator with network shaping (adb shell network delay + small heap). ~5% runs show duplicate POST. Customer reported duplicate resource creation once.

tara: quick mitigations: 1) stop retrying non-idempotent methods unless Idempotency-Key present, 2) ensure suspend path uses suspendCancellableCoroutine + call.enqueue so cancellation cancels the active call, 3) separate auth/refresh clients if refresh happens in-interceptor.

amos: agree. Also add telemetry when clone() is used so we can detect live duplicates. Add a CI emulator test that runs 500 iterations with shaped network and asserts single POST at server.

ci-bot: created ticket SDK-4301 and queued emulator stress job.

noah: I'll open a small PR with: cancellable enqueue wrapper for suspend, idempotency guard for POST retries, and a unit + emulator integration test. Will link sample repro in PR.

qa-ling: thanks — will run fuzz once build is ready and paste results here.
